debate_title: Should frontier AI developers be legally liable for harms...

conflicts.point: Whether pre-deployment safety audits impose prohibitive compliance costs that eliminate independent developers and entrench enterprise tech monopolies.

positions.stance: Mandatory safety audits create administrative bottlenecks and high compliance costs that lock garage developers out of the market and favor legacy cloud incumbents.
Audited safety cases provide a safe harbor that protects responsible developers while addressing unpriced systemic risks from high-risk deployments.

verdicts.conflict: Whether pre-deployment safety audits impose prohibitive compliance costs that eliminate independent developers and entrench enterprise tech monopolies.
verdicts.rationale: Claim 2 provides specific cost ranges spanning tens of thousands to a few hundred thousand euros, whereas Claim 1 relies on abstract assertions without equivalent quantitative backing. This empirical grounding makes the safetyist position more robust against immediate dismissal.
verdicts.whatWouldChange: Audited financial disclosure data showing that small open-source developers face millions in compliance costs per iteration would flip the verdict.
